scripts/verify-tauri-headless.sh booted papercusp-desktop on its own Xvfb display and drove the launcher Identity combobox in the real webview (2026-09-30T04:44:16.899Z -> 2026-09-30T04:44:31.918Z). Invalid and ineligible identities stay visible with a reason (true/true), and no disabled option lacks one. It passed on the first attempt.

The subject's activation rows were joined to the CTRL hook-context lines in its own native transcripts (3d1a8575, 4a35ae4e, 650999bd, 73f4a3dd). For generations 3, 5, 8, prepared < native emission < applied, and the applied row names the native that received the emission. Generations 7 and 11 are relaunch paths (warm respawn, --resume): the new native started on the re-rendered spec, its applied row is the acknowledgment, and the CTRL line follows it. Generation 2 was emitted at launch (line 8 of 3d1a8575 (full-resync)), then superseded by generation 3 before an acknowledgment turn: it has a prepared row and no applied row. Generations 9, 12 changed control state only (loop/carry), emitted CTRL and wrote no activation rows. No generation reports applied without a prior emission, and no ordering violation exists.

The refreshed render is proven by the file hash and by the next native (73f4a3dd).

Generations 4 and 6 (couple/decouple) have no CTRL hook-context line and no activation rows; the subject read them through coord:orient.

Cold forks receive their carry through loop-fire COLD LOOP WAKE prompts. 650999bd's second systemPrompt part (a carry document) is inherited from its warm-respawned parent; 73f4a3dd, forked from the resumed process, has one part.
